info.title: Lumeus Webhooks API
info.description:
Lumeus Webhooks API on Stellar. Sign up at https://app.lumeus.dev: Free, Starter, Growth and Scale plans are self-serve, Enterprise by agreement.

- **Pricing.** Testnet webhook deliveries cost no credits. A Free organization gets one Testnet endpoint with up to 1,000 deliveries a day. On paid plans each delivered Mainnet event costs 1 credit from the monthly balance. Calls to this management API are not charged. Plans, limits and credit weights: `GET https://api.lumeus.dev/v1/plans`.
- **Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer whk_…`, a webhook key from the dashboard. Webhook keys belong to one network, so pick the server that matches the key. `lum_` API keys are not accepted here (401).
- **Headers.** Every response carries X-Request-Id; authenticated responses carry RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; 429 and 503 carry Retry-After.
- **Errors.** JSON with a machine-readable code (see [errors](/guides/errors)). A path with an empty, `.` or `..` segment answers 400 invalid_request, a trailing slash answers 404 not_found, and a method the path does not accept answers 405 with an Allow header.
- **CORS.** Browser calls (CORS) are allowed from https://docs.lumeus.dev (the Try it playground of this reference) and https://app.lumeus.dev only, without cookies; responses expose ETag, Link, Location, Retry-After, X-Request-Id, X-Lumeus-Operation-Id, X-Lumeus-Idempotency and RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset (errors included). Other websites cannot read responses made with a server key: use a publishable key with your own allowed origins ([browser keys](/guides/browser-keys)).

post.description:
Creates a webhook endpoint that receives a signed POST for every event its filters match, and returns it with its `hmac_secret`. Save the secret: only this response shows it, and you need it to verify signatures. The endpoint is active at once and receives events from the ledger after `activation_checkpoint`.

- **Free plan:** one Testnet endpoint; deliveries cost no credits and are capped at 1,000 per organization per UTC day (later matches become free_quota_exhausted coverage gaps). Mainnet needs a paid plan.
- **Paid plans:** 10 (Starter), 50 (Growth), 250 (Scale) or 1,000 (Enterprise) endpoints per network. Testnet deliveries are free; each delivered Mainnet event costs 1 credit.
- **Retries:** resend the same Idempotency-Key and body to get the existing endpoint (200, without the secret); the same key with another body returns 409.
- **Payloads:** token_transfer, contract_event, balance.changed and webhook.test bodies and the signed headers are in the `delivery` callback of this operation and on [Receive webhooks](/webhooks/receive).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required, 1 to 128 characters. Resending the same key with the same body returns the existing endpoint (200, without hmac_secret) instead of creating a second one; the same key with a different body returns 409.

post.description:
Lumeus POSTs one event per request to your target_url. Verify X-Webhook-Signature over the raw body and the signed delivery context before you parse it ([verify](/webhooks/receive)), store the event under (network, id), then answer.

- Answer 2xx within 10 seconds with a body of at most 4 KiB. Anything else, including a redirect, is retried: 8 attempts, waiting 2 s and doubling up to 128 s.
- Each endpoint has exactly one delivery in flight; later events wait in ledger order.
- token_transfer and contract_event bodies use the Activity event model (without paging fields); on Mainnet network is pubnet.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Signature
parameters.description: Signature of the raw body: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>` with your whsec_ secret over `<t>.<body>`. Reject timestamps more than 300 seconds off.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Id
parameters.description: Delivery ID; negative for test deliveries.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Event-Id
parameters.description: The event id, the same as in the body.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Delivery-Context
parameters.description: Signed delivery context, base64url JSON: delivery and subscription IDs, event id, lane, network, generation and the SHA-256 of the body.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Context-Signature
parameters.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>` over the decoded context bytes.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Lane
parameters.description: live, replay or test (also inside the signed context).

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Subscription-Id
parameters.description: The subscription UUID.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Key-Version
parameters.description: Version of the signing key behind X-Webhook-Signature.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Test
parameters.description: true on test deliveries.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Replay-Id
parameters.description: Replay job ID, on replayed deliveries.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Next-Signature
parameters.description: During a key rotation only: the body signature made with the new key (also X-Webhook-Next-Context-Signature and X-Webhook-Next-Key-Version).

200.description: Delivered: any 2xx answer within 10 seconds counts.

patch.description: Changes an endpoint's name, target URL or filters, or pauses (state paused) or resumes (state active) it. Any other state answers 400 with the message `state must be active or paused; to delete an endpoint use DELETE /v1/subscriptions/{id}`. Send the current ETag as If-Match. Events matched while the endpoint is paused are not delivered later: they are recorded as paused_by_user coverage gaps. A request already in flight may still finish; inspect in_flight_attempts and pending_cancellation. Resending the same Idempotency-Key does not apply the change again.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Endpoint (subscription) ID from `POST /v1/subscriptions` or `GET /v1/subscriptions`. The example ID is a placeholder and answers 404: use your own.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Choose one key per change and resend it unchanged on a retry: the same key with the same request returns the first result instead of applying the change again, and the same key with a different request returns 409.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from `GET /v1/subscriptions/{id}`, for example `"1"` (the weak form `W/"1"` that some proxies produce is accepted too). A stale version returns 412; a missing header returns 428.

200.description: The changed endpoint.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Branch on code, not on the error text, which may change. RPC carries the same codes as the string error.data of a JSON-RPC error. invalid_request: 400: invalid input, including a malformed Idempotency-Key or an unknown or repeated query parameter (Webhooks also uses it for an oversized request body, 413). Fix the request; do not retry unchanged. unauthorized: 401: missing, revoked, invalid or wrong-network credential. payment_required: 402 (Mainnet): monthly credit quota exhausted on a hard-capped plan. forbidden: 403: the key or account policy does not allow this action. not_found: 404 (Webhooks also 410): the resource does not exist in this organization and network. topic_search_disabled: 404: contract-event topic search is not enabled on this network. method_not_allowed: 405: the route does not accept this method. conflict: 409: conflicting request identity, idempotency key, funding or recovery state. generation_changed: 409: the index generation or network changed since the snapshot was taken; restart the walk without generation and snapshot_ledger. history_unavailable: 409 (Assets): as_of_ledger is not answered from the balance history; start a snapshot job (POST /snapshots) or retry later. precondition_failed: 412 (Webhooks): the subscription version changed; fetch the current ETag. response_too_large: 413: the result exceeds the response budget; lower limit or narrow the request. precondition_required: 428 (Webhooks): If-Match with the subscription ETag is required. rate_limited: 429: a rate, concurrency or credit-cap limit was reached, or (Activity, Assets and RPC on Testnet) the daily Testnet request cap (message `daily Testnet request cap of 10000 reached; resets at 00:00 UTC`, Retry-After until 00:00 UTC). Wait Retry-After seconds (a refused request consumes nothing). A Retry-After greater than 60 means the daily Testnet cap: wait until 00:00 UTC or switch to Mainnet. RPC carries it as the string error.data. internal_error: 500 or another unexpected 5xx; quote request_id when contacting support. not_implemented: 501: the feature is not enabled on this host. busy: 503: reads are saturated (the queue wait expired or the database refused another query or ran short of memory). Retry the same request after Retry-After (2) seconds. query_timeout: 503: the read ran out of time. Do not retry unchanged right away: narrow the ledger range (since_ledger/until_ledger) or lower limit; Retry-After is 30. index_not_ready: 503: the index or snapshot is not ready yet or is rebuilding; retry after Retry-After seconds. topic_coverage: 503: the effective range is outside the contract-event topic index coverage (the message states it); pass a range inside it or retry after Retry-After (60) seconds. unavailable: 503: another temporary failure (billing, rate limiter, queue); retry after Retry-After seconds.

target_url.description: Public HTTPS URL. DNS and dial-time SSRF validation reject private targets.

asset.description: native or CODE:ISSUER. Balance events also accept a C… token contract (a SAC selects its classic asset) or `pool:<64 hex>`.

event_types.description: Empty means every decoded event type. Token-transfer types: transfer, mint, burn, clawback, fee. Balance events are opt-in: list balance.changed, or balance.changed.fees to include fee-only XLM changes. Any other value selects contract events by their first topic symbol and must be a Soroban symbol (1-32 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and _); anything else is a 400. target_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the signed POSTs.

hmac_secret.description: Returned only by the first successful creation; retries do not reveal it.

event_types.description: Event type filter; absent or empty means every decoded event type.

active.description: True while the endpoint receives events.

admission_protocol.description: Delivery protocol version (2: deliveries carry a signed context).

version.description: Endpoint version, also in the ETag header. Every change increments it.

desired_state.description: What you asked for: active, paused or deleted.

effective_state.description: What applies now: active, activating, paused_by_user, paused_by_funding (for example the free daily cap was reached) or deleted.

slot_state.description: metered for paid-plan endpoints, sponsored for the free Testnet endpoint, held for prepaid funded endpoints.

sponsored.description: True for the one free Testnet endpoint of a Free organization: deliveries are not charged credits but are capped per UTC day, and replays are not available.

metered.description: True for a paid-plan endpoint: every delivered Mainnet event costs the catalog webhook credit weight (1 credit) from the organization's monthly balance, with overage billed on paid plans. Testnet deliveries, and failed, cancelled and expired deliveries, cost nothing. Replays are not yet available for paid endpoints.

signing_version.description: Version of the current signing secret; rotation increments it.

generation.description: Event index generation the endpoint reads.

activation_checkpoint.description: The endpoint receives events from the ledger after this one. Read earlier history from the Activity API.

effective_checkpoint.description: Last ledger the endpoint's state applies to.

last_scanned_ledger.description: Last ledger scanned for matching events.

last_fully_admitted_ledger.description: Last ledger whose matching events were all queued for delivery.

admitted.description: Admitted today; deliveries cancelled before any attempt are given back.

free_quota.description: Free Testnet endpoints only, on `GET /v1/subscriptions/{id}`: the organization's admitted and delivered deliveries today (UTC) against its daily cap.

endpoint_limit.description: Paid endpoints allowed per network on this plan.

endpoints_used.description: Active paid endpoints of the organization on this network.

warnings.description: Create and update responses only: non-fatal filter warnings, such as a probable event type typo.

pending_policy.description: What happens to deliveries already queued: drain_old still sends them, cancel_old cancels those not yet attempted. Required when target_url changes; optional when a selector (account, asset, contract_addr, event_types) changes (default drain_old); rejected with 400 when neither changes. A change that alters nothing returns 200 with the version unchanged.

warnings.description: Non-fatal filter warnings for this change.

secret.description: New whsec_ value returned once on rotation, absent on retry or revocation.
Plaintext whk_ key, first creation only.

last_used_at.description: Updated at most once a minute.

expires_at.description: The key stops authenticating at this time. Absent: never expires.

next_attempt_at.description: Next attempt or lease expiry while pending; null once delivered or dead.

last_error.description: Coarse failure class, for example receiver timed out, receiver refused the connection, TLS handshake with the receiver failed, target address is not allowed, or non-2xx response: 503.

credits.description: Paid endpoints: credits charged for this delivered event.

reason.description: For example paused_by_user, awaiting_activation, funding_exhausted, payload_or_policy_limit (more than 4,096 matches in one ledger, or an oversized event), free_quota_exhausted (free Testnet daily cap), free_webhooks_disabled, plan_not_entitled (paid endpoint while the organization is not on a paid plan), paid_webhooks_disabled or multiple_causes.

historical_until_ledger.description: Exclusive Activity boundary: activation checkpoint + 1. Null before activation.

last_ledger.description: Inclusive end; must satisfy the selected bounded source policy.

SourceReplayRequest.description: At most 64 consecutive inclusive ledgers and 128 deliveries, further bounded by the selected source policy.

kind.description: retained: a redelivery of retained payloads; source: a source replay.

holder.description: Account or contract that holds the balance.

asset.description: native, CODE:ISSUER, a C… contract token, or `pool:<hex>` for a liquidity pool share. Never a SAC address.

contract_address.description: The SAC for native and classic assets, the token contract for contract tokens; absent for pool shares.

balance.description: New balance after the ledger as a decimal string. Absent when decimals is unknown.

balance_raw.description: New balance as an exact integer string.

previous_balance_raw.description: Balance before the ledger (0 when it did not exist).

decimals.description: 7 for native, classic, SAC and pool shares; the token's decimals for contract tokens. Absent when unknown.

archived.description: The contract balance entry was evicted to the archive; its value is unchanged.

deleted.description: The trustline or balance entry was removed; balance is 0.

BalanceChangedEvent.description: balance.changed: one event per holder, asset and ledger, carrying the value after the ledger. Opt in with event_types balance.changed (or balance.changed.fees to include fee-only XLM changes).
